entities.title: Page
entities.summary: The game's HTML page, its styles, its icon and the headers Cloudflare serves with them.
entities.purpose: Holds what the build copies unchanged into dist/games/lundey/: index.html with the canvas, a cross of touch buttons with PLAY or PAUSE in its middle, the sound button and the site's footer links; lundey.css, which scales the 336 × 420 screen to fit, puts the buttons under it on phones and beside it on a phone held sideways, and hides the cross on a keyboard-and-mouse device; icon.svg; and _headers, which the build moves to the root of dist/.
boundaries: No script of its own: the build adds game.js from src/main.ts. The content security policy in _headers allows script, style and connections from this origin only, with no inline script or style.
The page asks not to be indexed, in its own meta tag and in _headers.
build.mjs skips this .dev/ when it copies the folder, so it is never served (games/.dev/decisions.json, publish-dev-files).
